scope: Original2302–2305 Orient, Settle, Shrinkwrap and Trim full bodies, and separately attributed historical records.

observations.trace: Public Settle.equilibrium takes an arbitrary rest slice and calls solve; solve computes n-1 before checking magnitude or selecting the iterations. An empty slice therefore crosses the unsigned extent boundary.
observations.remaining: Original Lens12 delegate758 reported q374; overflow-checked and wrapping outcomes differ. The normal nonempty Strands producer and public slice API are distinct. No arithmetic, object, panic or product path was executed.

observations.trace: Trim returns for nonpositive total, preserves a finite clamped kept fraction, and returns when its cut has fewer than two points before calling resample_into.
observations.remaining: This narrows the previously established short-resampler q381 on this specific call. Unusual subnormal or NaN inputs, exact arc-length producer and other callers remain open; no unsupported blanket guarantee or executed case.

observations.trace: Settle intentionally returns early for reference gravity in relative mode. Orient skips nonpositive memory and holds each root fixed. Shrinkwrap supports explicit lock_roots and smoothing policies.
observations.remaining: Original Adler369 and delegate758/759 already identified these modes. For a custom unlocked shrinkwrap, cached map invalidation and collider finite/query policy remain open; generated-look positive offsets and default lock are narrower. No visual or runtime result is established.
